name: Deepsight
body:
Source Advanced Player's Guide pg. 157
Your senses are especially keen in the utter darkness.

Prerequisites: Darkvision 60 feet.

Benefit: Your darkvision has a range of 120 feet.

Normal: Darkvision normally extends 60 or 90 feet.
Mythic Deepsight
Source Mythic Adventures pg. 62
Your sharp eyes can penetrate deeper into the darkness, revealing more to you.

Prerequisites: DeepsightAPG.

Benefit: The range of your darkvision increases by 10 feet per tier.
